author: The Linux Foundation
description:
Join us at the premier vendor-neutral open source conference, where developers and technologists come together to collaborate, share knowledge, and explore the latest innovations and advancements in open source technology. Learn more at https://events.linuxfoundation.org/

Keynote: LF Energy: An Innovative Ecosystem Powering the Future of Energy Through Open Source - Christophe Villemer, Executive Vice President, Savoir-faire Linux

LF Energy brings together utilities, vendors, and technology leaders to build an open and innovative ecosystem for the future of energy. By sharing open platforms, common standards, and production-grade technologies such as SEAPATH, the community accelerates digitalization, strengthens resilience, and reduces vendor lock-in. This keynote will highlight how collaborative open source development creates real business value for grid operators and industry players, and why it is becoming essential for modern, interoperable, and future-ready energy systems.
